formulas.text: forall l' : list A, length (l ++ l') = length l + length l'
forall l' : list A, length (l ++ l') = length l + length l'
forall l' : list A, @eq nat (@length A (@app A (@nil A) l')) (Init.Nat.add (@length A (@nil A)) (@length A l'))
forall (a : A) (l0 : list A), (forall l' : list A, length (l0 ++ l') = length l0 + length l') -> forall l' : list A, length ((a :: l0) ++ l') = length (a :: l0) + length l'
forall l' : list A, length (l0 ++ l') = length l0 + length l'
S (length (l0 ++ l')) = S (length l0 + length l')
length (l0 ++ l') = length l0 + length l'
